曲线覆盖的内外范围偏窄，参数可能互相补偿；请补充更靠内、外的点。: The inner/outer range covered by the curve is narrow, so parameters may compensate for each other. Add points further inward and outward.
曲线偏差较大，请检查照片矫正、点位和是否始终沿同一条线标点。: The curve deviates substantially. Check the photo rectification, the point positions, and whether the points always follow the same line.
最佳结果靠近搜索边界，建议扩大搜索范围并补充曲线点复核。: The best result is near the search boundary. Widen the search range and add curve points to check.
当前曲线对两个半径的约束较相似，暂不能仅凭低残差判断参数唯一；请扩大径向覆盖并检: The current curve constrains the two radii in a similar way, so low residuals alone cannot show that the parameters are unique. Widen the radial coverage and check point accuracy.
存在形状接近的参数候选，请对照整条曲线后再应用。: There are parameter candidates with similar shapes. Compare the whole curve before applying.
宽范围只进行了有限多起点搜索，候选列表不代表穷尽所有可能参数。: A wide range was searched with only a limited number of starting points, so the candidate list does not cover every possible parameter set.
角度展开以相邻点之间没有遗漏整圈为前提；请对照完整曲线，在弯曲或绕行处补点后确认: Angle unwrapping assumes no whole turn is missing between adjacent points. Compare against the full curve and add points at bends or windings before confirming.
曲线出现明显向内回退，请按内到外的顺序沿同一条线标点。: The curve clearly backtracks inward. Place points along the same line in order from the inside outward.
相邻曲线点转角接近半圈，无法判断是否漏掉整圈；请在这两点之间沿实际曲线补点。: The turn between adjacent curve points is close to a half turn, so a missed whole turn cannot be ruled out. Add points along the actual curve between these two points.
曲线点较多，拟合使用均匀抽取的点；完整顺序仍用于角度展开。: There are many curve points, so the fit uses evenly sampled points; the full order is still used for angle unwrapping.
预测曲线需要有限、递增且大于零的观测半径区间。: The predicted curve needs a finite, increasing observation radius range greater than zero.

完整曲线采样超出点数上限；请缩小预测范围或提高采样上限后再确认形状。: The full-curve sampling exceeds the point limit. Narrow the prediction range or raise the sampling limit, then check the shape again.
三次轨距拟合需要至少 12 个不同半径的点且覆盖至少 60% 绘图区；本次保持轨: Cubic track pitch fitting needs at least 12 points at different radii covering at least 60% of the drawing area. This time the pitch coefficients are kept and only the inner and outer radii are fitted.
三次轨距没有带来稳定改善，保留原轨距系数；可增加内、中、外圈点位后重试。: The cubic track pitch gave no stable improvement, so the original pitch coefficients are kept. Add points on the inner, middle and outer rings and try again.
当前点位无法稳定区分三个轨距系数与内外半径，本次保留原轨距系数；请扩大径向覆盖并: The current points cannot reliably distinguish the three pitch coefficients from the inner and outer radii, so the original pitch coefficients are kept. Widen the radial coverage and improve point accuracy.
已拟合 DVD 三次轨距；三个形状系数与内外半径可能互相补偿，低残差不表示参数唯: The DVD cubic track pitch was fitted. The three shape coefficients and the inner/outer radii may compensate for each other, and low residuals do not mean the parameters are unique. Check the whole predicted curve before applying.
轨距系数接近搜索边界，请复核点位，必要时扩大系数搜索范围。: A pitch coefficient is near the search boundary. Check the point positions and widen the coefficient search range if needed.
搜索半径范围应在 0–5 mm 内，控制点容差应在 0–10 mm 内，轨距系数: The search radius range should be within 0–5 mm, the control point tolerance within 0–10 mm, and the pitch coefficient search range within 0–10.
至少确认 4 个用于拟合的角点，并选择分布在不同半径的控制块；验证组与未确认角点: Confirm at least 4 corner points for fitting and choose control blocks spread across different radii. The validation group and unconfirmed corner points are not used in the fit.
控制点集中在相近半径，无法稳定区分内外半径；请补选靠内圈或外圈的角点。: The control points are concentrated at similar radii, so the inner and outer radii cannot be told apart reliably. Select more corner points near the inner or outer ring.
搜索范围内没有有效模型，请检查控制点对应关系或扩大搜索范围。: No valid model exists within the search range. Check how the control points correspond, or widen the search range.
控制点覆盖的径向范围偏窄，建议补选更靠内、外的角点复核。: The radial range covered by the control points is narrow. Select corner points further inward and outward to check.
控制点与预测图形偏差较大，请检查分组与弧片身份、控制点对应关系和显示尺度。: The control points deviate substantially from the predicted figure. Check the grouping, the arc identity, the control point correspondence and the display scale.
最佳结果靠近搜索边界，建议扩大搜索范围并补充控制点复核。: The best result is near the search boundary. Widen the search range and add control points to check.
存在拟合程度接近的绕圈候选，暂不能唯一确定参数；请在预测差异明显的另一半径补选角: There are winding candidates with similar fit, so the parameters cannot yet be determined uniquely. Select additional corner points at another radius where the predictions differ clearly.
搜索范围包含过多绕圈组合，已进行有限多起点搜索；请缩小范围或增加分散的控制点后复: The search range contains too many winding combinations, so a limited multi-start search was performed. Narrow the range or add more widely spread control points, then check again.

外缘和内缘各需要至少 5 个分散的点，且每条轮廓不超过 256 个点。: The outer and inner edges each need at least 5 well-spread points, and each outline can have at most 256 points.

轮廓点重复或接近一条直线，请沿外缘和内缘分别分散布点。: The outline points are duplicated or nearly collinear. Spread points around the outer and inner edges separately.
外缘轮廓无法形成稳定椭圆，请核对实体外缘上的点。: The outer-edge outline cannot form a stable ellipse. Check the points on the physical outer edge.
内缘轮廓与外缘位置不符，请确认选中的是贯通的实体内缘，而非盘面的印刷圆环。: The inner-edge outline does not match the position of the outer edge. Make sure you selected the continuous physical inner edge, not a printed ring on the disc face.
两条轮廓不能得到有效的联合投影，请检查布点。: The two outlines cannot produce a valid joint projection. Check the point placement.
拍摄角度或轮廓对应关系导致投影退化，请换角度拍摄或重新布点。: The shooting angle or the outline correspondence degenerates the projection. Shoot from another angle or place the points again.
轮廓点集中在局部，请在两条完整圆周的不同方向补点。: The outline points are concentrated locally. Add points in different directions around both full circles.
